before.title: Food service permit renewals — synthetic fixture
before.content:
Demo fixture only — not a real ordinance or permit rule.
Renewal packets may be uploaded as PDF.
Inspection scheduling requests should be submitted at least 72 hours in advance.
Questions: permits@example.gov

after.title: Food service permit renewals — synthetic fixture
after.content:
Demo fixture only — not a real ordinance or permit rule.
Renewal packets may be uploaded as PDF or PDF/A.
Inspection scheduling requests should be submitted at least 5 business days in advance.
Questions: permits@example.gov
